image-popup.description: Rounded photo card with a title (and optional subtitle) below; eased slide/scale/fade in and out. HDR-safe (compose).

lower-third.description: Compact legible label/callout card with a controlled entrance/exit. HDR-safe (compose).

kinetic-captions.description: Timed ASS captions with per-word karaoke emphasis from reviewed word cues (no transcription pass).

comparison.description: Picture-in-picture: an inset image (compose) or clip (overlay, SDR only) with an optional label card.

clip-transitions.description: Ordered clips joined with fade/dissolve/wipe transitions; audio crossfades with the picture.

look.description: Editorial / vintage / monochrome grade from the existing stylize op. Needs an approved look (retained 2-3 still-option workflow); SDR only.

narration-mix.description: Narration placed at a cue time, optional music bed ducked under it, optional loudness normalization.
